subject: Coordination — Technical onboarding & migration review (Redwood ↔ Acme)
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: bob.patel@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + request: migration review and PoC kickoff

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team was encouraged by the latency and cost profile you showed. We'd like to schedule a technical architecture review to walk through our current self-hosted stack, constraints around KV cache retention, and the migration path for our model artifacts. Our engineering leads (cc'd) are also interested in how Redwood handles fallbacks when capacity is constrained.

Proposed window: next Wednesday (8/11) morning PT or Thursday (8/12) afternoon PT. Can your team do a 90-minute deep-dive? We'll want to invite our infra partner (Switchbox) if possible.

Attachments: sample telemetry + current SLOs attached (Acme_Metrics_Sample.csv).

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Director of Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

[Attachment: Acme_Metrics_Sample.csv (CSV, 48 KB)]

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>, bob.patel@acme-corp.com
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: migration review and PoC kickoff

Hi Alice — great to hear. Monica (solutions engineering) and Lauren (product) are looped to make sure we cover runtime specifics and rollout policy constraints. 90 minutes is sensible.

Quick availability from our side:
- Tue 8/10 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 8/11 08:30–10:00 PT
- Thu 8/12 13:00–14:30 PT

If you prefer to include Switchbox, we can make Wed 8/11 the primary option and send a calendar invite once you confirm. I'll also attach a short runbook we typically use for PoC onboarding so your team can pre-read.

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: POC_Scope_Runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 82 KB)]

From: Bob Patel <bob.patel@acme-corp.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: migration review and PoC kickoff

Rishi — thanks, those options mostly work. Switchbox is available Wed 8/11 but only after 11:00 PT, so that would miss your earlier slot. We can do Thu 8/12 13:00–14:30 PT which works for all internal stakeholders. Can Monica cover both the KV cache and quantization/compatibility sections? If so, confirm and I'll send a calendar hold.

On another note, we have a compliance checkpoint on Monday morning that may require us to change scope slightly (audit logs retention), so there is a small chance we need to push by a day — I'll flag that ASAP.

Thanks,
Bob
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Acme Corp

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: bob.patel@acme-corp.com, alice.chen@acme-corp.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, eng@switchbox.io
Date: 2027-08-05T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: migration review and PoC kickoff

Hi Bob / Alice — Monica here. Happy to cover KV cache strategy, quantization compatibility, and our fallback routing policies. Proposed run order for the 90-minute session:

1) 5m — Intros and success criteria (Rishi with Alice)
2) 20m — Acme current infra + constraints (Acme team)
3) 25m — Redwood runtime internals (monica) — KV cache, batching behavior, kernel selection
4) 20m — Migration path and rollouts (lauren) — model pins, canary, fallback variants
5) 15m — Open Q&A + next steps (all)

Please confirm the Thu 8/12 13:00–14:30 PT slot and whether Switchbox will join (I've cc'ed their eng alias). If audit logs are a concern, bring any retention requirements — we can show the Private deployment options and KMS integration.

Also attaching the runbook and a slide with our typical migration checklist so you can review before the meeting.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: POC_Scope_Runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 82 KB)]
[Attachment: Migration_Checklist_v2.pptx (PPTX, 1.2 MB)]

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, bob.patel@acme-corp.com
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, eng@switchbox.io
Date: 2027-08-06T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coordination — Technical onboarding & migration review (Redwood ↔ Acme)

Confirmed for Thu 8/12 13:00–14:30 PT. Calendar invite sent (accepted by Alice, Bob). Switchbox confirmed attendance. We had the compliance checkpoint and there is a small change: audit logs retention required for 24 months for this pilot. Monica / Lauren — can you add a 5-minute note on long-term retention options and KMS integration at the end of the migration path section? Otherwise, we're ready.

I'll circulate a short list of sample queries and a short dataset we'll bring to ensure the KV cache conversation is concrete. Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Best,
Alice

[Calendar invite: Redwood-Acme Technical Review — Thu 2027-08-12 13:00–14:30 PT (Accepted)]
